title: Preserve GLM partial results and lifecycle bookkeeping
description: A GLM run returned a structured partial result after 27m07s with exit code 1, but the MCP wrapper marked it isError=true. The normal PostToolUse finish hook was not recorded, leaving agent-evals running and prompting the parent to stop despite AGENTS.md requiring native fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Structured partial worker output is returned as non-transport-error status=partial even with a nonzero process exit; focused tests cover wrapper formatting; the current stale run is recovered and labelable; AGENTS.md explicitly requires recovery plus native/local continuation after partial/error/timeout.
close_reason: Fixed MCP classification for structured partial results, added durable patching and 11 passing regression/integration tests, reconciled and labeled the affected run, strengthened project recovery guidance, and passed review-mcp.

title: Prevent GLM worker timeout result loss
description: The independent GLM worker has twice reached the configured 10-minute ceiling. Completed edits can remain in the shared worktree while the parent receives no usable result, and assistant output is lost because sub-agents-mcp only structures terminal result events.
design: Patch the pinned local sub-agents-mcp 0.12.1 runtime through an idempotent postinstall script, test StreamProcessor/timeout integration behavior with Node tests, and configure a 30-minute worker ceiling with a larger outer MCP tool timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Raise internal GLM execution timeout and outer MCP timeout coherently; return accumulated Claude-compatible assistant text as a structured partial result on internal timeout; make the runtime patch survive npm reinstall; add and pass focused regression tests; obtain review-mcp review.
close_reason: Implemented durable timeout recovery, raised coordinated ceilings, passed 8 regression/integration tests, and completed review-mcp review.

title: Align SIGTERM-without-result MCP error classification
description: Review of the GLM partial-result fix found a pre-existing inconsistency: child exit 143 without a structured result produces MCP isError=false but structured status=error. Decide whether 143 should be exempt only when a result exists, then add wrapper-level regression coverage.

title: Add first-class e621 provider support
description: Create and implement an OpenSpec change for a native e621 metadata adapter covering bounded post fetch and artist-attribution enumeration, tag/alias/artist metadata, candidate lookup, artist-library expansion, and verified media acquisition under e621's documented API, User-Agent, authentication, pagination, rate, privacy, and availability contracts. Exclude Gelbooru, recursive discovery, similarity, favorites, bulk DB exports, automatic identity decisions, and implicit downloads.
notes: OpenSpec add-e621-metadata-adapter paused at 15/30 tasks after completing and section-reviewing schema/adapter normalization plus remote metadata synchronization and CLI (tasks 1.1-4.3). Migrations 0009/0010, native adapter, fixtures, durable tag/alias operations, e621 metadata commands, retry/budget/resume/privacy hardening are implemented. Full pytest, Ruff, ty, diff-check pass. Remaining work starts at 5.1 candidate lookup, then library expansion, acquisition, docs/live smoke/final verification. Change remains active and unarchived.

title: Add artist-library expansion workflow
description: Create and implement an OpenSpec change that resolves confirmed or explicitly selected stable targets into typed, bounded artist-library expansion plans; executes and resumes metadata-only enumeration through existing adapter/checkpoint contracts; retains seed and handoff provenance; and feeds existing media browsing and acquisition without recursion, implicit downloads, or inherited liked/bookmarked state.
notes: Implementation complete. Added bounded artist-library target planning, provider capabilities/count probes, metadata-only execution/resume lineage, target-scoped inspection/media handoff, CLI/docs, and migration 0008. Review findings addressed: capability and selection-note plan identity, estimate-neutral run/resume staleness, stored-plan origin binding, exact probe-history truncation, and fail-closed provider routing. Final gates: changed-file Ruff format check, ruff check ., ty check src, strict OpenSpec validation, git diff --check, and full pytest all pass.
close_reason: OpenSpec implementation complete and fully verified; ready to archive.

title: Resolve first-party ty baseline diagnostics
description: Work down the gradual ty baseline in first-party src code. After the initial tooling adoption, ty 0.0.70 reports 107 warning-level diagnostics: 60 invalid-argument-type, 45 unresolved-attribute, and 2 possibly-unresolved-reference. Fix these at dynamic SQLite, JSON normalization, storage root, and adapter protocol boundaries without blanket ignores or further severity downgrades; then remove --exit-zero from the repository-wide AGENTS command and make ty blocking.
acceptance_criteria: uv run ty check src exits successfully without --exit-zero and without lowering additional rules or adding blanket ignores; AGENTS.md uses the plain repository-wide command as a required quality gate; focused tests and Ruff remain green.
close_reason: Resolved all 107 first-party ty diagnostics at typed SQLite, provider JSON, storage, and adapter boundaries; removed warning downgrades and made plain ty check a required gate; full Ruff, ty, formatting, and pytest gates pass.

title: Add Ruff formatting and ty type-checking workflow
description: Adapt the applicable Ruff formatting/lint configuration, ty dependency and type-checking configuration, and AGENTS quality-gate guidance from the adjacent sd-scripts project. Keep this repository's stricter existing choices where appropriate, exclude only genuinely vendored code, update the lockfile, and verify the resulting checks.
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml declares and configures Ruff formatting and ty for Python 3.13; AGENTS.md documents lint, format, test, and type-check commands suitable for this repo; uv.lock is synchronized; Ruff, ty, and pytest outcomes are verified and any gradual-adoption warnings are documented accurately.
close_reason: Added and verified Ruff formatting/lint policy, ty dependency/configuration and AGENTS workflow; fixed the two error-level first-party ty findings; recorded the remaining warning baseline in follow-up data-processing-ryf.

title: Add evolving project roadmap
description: Create a concise, durable roadmap that explains the project goal, completed capabilities, current active work, next milestone, future directions, deferred work, and how Roadmap/OpenSpec/Beads/CHANGELOG responsibilities differ. Link it from the main documentation entry points.
acceptance_criteria: ROADMAP.md is discoverable from README and docs index; it accurately reflects completed catalog capabilities and current empty active-work state; future work is prioritized without duplicating Beads tasks or the detailed architecture plan.
close_reason: Created ROADMAP.md with project goal, current capabilities, active-state guidance, next artist-library milestone, later work, principles, and maintenance rules; linked from README and docs index.

title: Remove obsolete shell boilerplate from AGENTS.md
description: Remove the remaining Beads-generated non-interactive shell command section so AGENTS.md contains only project-specific Python quality gates and the generated Codex Beads setup block.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md no longer contains force-overwrite, recursive rm/cp, SSH, apt, or brew boilerplate; Python quality guidance and the generated Codex Beads block remain intact.
close_reason: Removed the remaining generated non-interactive shell and force-overwrite boilerplate from AGENTS.md.

title: Deduplicate Beads guidance in AGENTS.md
description: Remove the manual Beads introduction and older overlapping integration block from AGENTS.md, retaining the repository-specific shell/Python guidance and the generated Codex Beads setup block as the single local Beads pointer.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md contains one Beads guidance block, preserves the generated Codex setup markers and project-specific quality/shell instructions, and has no duplicated Beads quick-reference or architecture text.
close_reason: Removed the manual and older managed Beads sections; retained the generated Codex Beads setup block as the sole local Beads guidance.
